meta.question: does L_SM run backwards as well as forwards?

forwards.name: Maxwell
forwards.theory: classical U(1) field, F_μν, no ħ, no charges as spinors
forwards.back_from_sm: QED tree / ħ → 0, keep A_μ = photon after Weinberg rotation
forwards.fwd_to_next: add charges and ħ → Dirac + Maxwell → QED
forwards.why: The photon kinetic term in L2/L3 is Maxwell once fermions and loops are stripped.

forwards.name: Dirac
forwards.back_from_sm: keep one charged fermion, turn off all non-U(1) gauge fields, replace yv by m
forwards.why: Block 3 kinetic + block 4 mass term, one flavor, no W/Z/g.

forwards.name: Fermi_4fermion
forwards.back_from_sm: E ≪ M_W: integrate out W, G_F = g² / (4√2 M_W²)
forwards.fwd_to_next: promote contact term to SU(2) gauge boson → GWS
forwards.why: A real low-energy limit of L2+L3. Not a UV theory.

forwards.name: QED
forwards.back_from_sm: after SSB: e = g sin θ_W, keep A_μ, drop W, Z, gluons, Higgs fluctuations
forwards.fwd_to_next: nonabelian copy of the same idea → Yang–Mills
forwards.why: QED sits inside SM as the unbroken U(1)_EM. e is composed, not primitive.

forwards.name: Yang_Mills
forwards.theory: nonabelian F = dA + A∧A, cubic/quartic gluon or W self-coupling
forwards.back_from_sm: drop fermions and Higgs; keep one simple factor (SU(3) or SU(2))
forwards.fwd_to_next: add SSB + mixing → GWS; add color + quarks → QCD
forwards.why: Block 1 is SU(3) YM. Block 2 contains SU(2) YM before the VEV.

forwards.name: GWS_electroweak
forwards.theory: SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y + Higgs, Weinberg rotation, W/Z masses
forwards.back_from_sm: turn off g_s; drop QCD sector
forwards.fwd_to_next: add SU(3)_c + quarks → SM (modulo generations / QCD)
forwards.why: Blocks 2–4. θ_W and v still inputs.

forwards.name: QCD
forwards.back_from_sm: turn off g, g'; keep colored quarks + gluons
forwards.why: Block 1 + the color part of block 3. UV-free, IR-confining.

forwards.name: KM_three_gen
forwards.theory: third family, CKM phase, CP in the charged current
forwards.back_from_sm: keep three copies of the fermion reps and the Yukawa matrices
forwards.why: Three copies are an input. Running backwards to one generation is a toy, not the SM.

forwards.name: SM_poster
forwards.theory: L_SM as assembled: QCD + GWS + 3 families + Higgs (found 2012)
forwards.fwd_to_next: add S_EH + Λ → Einstein + T_SM (not a term in L_SM)
forwards.why: The poster. Consumes the couplings. Does not produce them.

forwards.name: Einstein_plus_T
forwards.back_from_sm: cannot. G and Λ are not in L_SM
forwards.fwd_to_next: this is the universe couple, not a prior layer of the poster
forwards.why: Forwards from SM you must ADD gravity. Backwards from the couple you can drop EH and recover L_SM on η.

limits.name: SM_to_QED
limits.map: SSB then e = g s_W, keep A_μ, drop W/Z/g/H fluc

limits.name: SM_to_Fermi
limits.forward: Fermi is the IR of GWS

limits.name: SM_to_YM
limits.map: drop matter and VEV, keep one factor

limits.name: SM_to_one_group
limits.map: run couplings backward (UV) until they meet

limits.name: SM_to_NS
limits.map: gluon cubic or continuum limit → Navier–Stokes

dots: Maxwell → Dirac → QED → Fermi sits beside → YM → GWS + QCD + KM → SM. Einstein+T is added, not recovered. A one-group UV is not recovered.
how_far: wound the poster back through Maxwell, Dirac, Fermi, QED, YM, GWS, QCD, KM
four limits pass both ways: QED, Fermi, Maxwell, YM
UV meet of the three couplings fails (already gauge3)
Einstein+T does not sit inside L_SM; you add it
NS is not on this line
running backwards recovers prior theories, not the values of the couplings
next_da_move: The SM runs backwards to its ancestors by named limits. It does not run backwards to F. Fluids stay on B.
